verdict.rationale: Yapily documents bulk payments: a dedicated bulk-payment authorisation endpoint, and bulk listed among the API payment types (Hosted Pages does not yet support it). That is a real first-party bulk operation, but it is limited to payment initiation and thinly documented. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond payments (e.g. batch data retrieval or consent management), details on batch size limits and per-item status handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Used to initiate the authorisation process and direct users to the login screen of their financial Institution in order to give their consent for a bulk payment.
Choose this when you need payment types Hosted does not yet support (bulk, scheduled, periodic, international)
